name: ir_priority
purpose: After collection and analysis: what does the evidence say the response should be, and is the incident contained? Feeds the operator's report — never triggers actions by itself (actuate has its own gates).
state_template: EVIDENCE: <timeline highlights, correlated findings, collection observations>. CURRENT STATE: <host role, what has been contained or cleaned so far, operator actions taken>.

data_exfiltration_risk.instructions: Does the evidence indicate data likely left the host (outbound conns, archive creation, USB activity, large writes to removable media)?

lateral_movement.instructions: Does the evidence indicate movement to or from other hosts (shared logon ids, cross-host logons, peer credential use)?

response.instructions: What response does the evidence support right now?

criteria.contain_now: Isolate and respond through actuate — active compromise
criteria.investigate: Keep collecting — evidence points to compromise but is not conclusive
criteria.harden: No compromise — close with hygiene actions (stale credentials, NTP, audit policy)
criteria.close: Benign — record the case and close

confidence_note.instructions: How complete is this evidence set?
criteria: Comprehensive — all DFIR questions plus timeline
